Activity_Log.all_generated_reports: Same deny rule, including the observed Activity_Log_Report. Do not infer safe permissions from a generated report's name.
Activity_Log.admin: Read-only inspection through report; native direct form saves/deletes rejected by validation.
Activity_Log.server: Native authenticated Deluge helpers own insertion and attempt state updates. No generic client write-log API.

native_profile_readback.limit: The capture proves the five visible Activity Log controls are unchecked on all nine profile rows. It is not an end-user runtime authorization or email-delivery test.

notification_contacts.login_and_approval: A row without native User is a notification contact only. Name/email matching never authenticates it or elevates it into approval routing.

budget_activity: Existing authenticated budget/PO visibility determines read access; existing PO retry authorization determines email retry access. The caller cannot select another budget's object/event by swapping IDs.
Settings: Preserve existing Settings editor access and native update rules; no new broad report/roster permission.
Territory: Preserve existing Territory edit access; Construction PM notification assignment grants no application or approval permission.
